sections.what: Draws the back link, logo, title, optional demo link, extra controls, theme switch and optional Yard views list.

sections.watch_out: The demo link appears only when a demo address is passed in.

summary: The header bar for individual tool pages, with a back link, the tool title and icon, an optional demo link, extra controls, and an optional list of Yard views.
purpose: Lets a visitor go back to all tools, see which tool they are in, and jump to a demo or the saved views.
why: Likely reason: one shared header with optional parts, so each tool can add or hide controls without its own header.
how: Shows a back arrow to the tools page, then the optional logo, then the title with its icon and the product name. On the right it shows an optional demo link, any extra controls passed in, and the theme switch. When views are enabled, a collapsible section lists the Yard views.
inputs: A title, an icon, an optional demo link and its label, extra controls, a views flag and a neutral brand flag.
outputs: A rendered header. Its links navigate to other pages.
risks: A missing demo address hides the demo link without any message.
debug: If the demo link is missing, check the `demoHref` value passed in. If the logo is gone, check the `neutralBrand` flag.
